x: On 25th August Brian Hallowell and Jack Brown competed in a 25 minutes Paarlauf at Ladywell which resulted as follows: 1st pair Gordon Pirie and John Evans - 5 miles 1740 yards. 3rd pair, B. Hallowell and J.
At Mitcham we were up to 9th place but still 1½ mins. behind Poly. who had taken over the lead through a great run by John Evans. Charlie was the second fastest of the day.
